test_title: PYST 3: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held On 10 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Choose the most suitable option to replace the highlighted part of the sentence:

He **availed of the** **opportunity** well.
solution:
The correct answer is '**availed himself of the opportunity**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct phrase is "**availed himself of the opportunity**" because the verb "avail" is typically used with a reflexive pronoun.
 
• The phrase means "to make use of the opportunity" in an appropriate manner.
 
• **Options 1, 3, 4, and 5** are incorrect because they do not follow the standard grammatical construction of the verb "avail."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"He **availed himself of the opportunity**__ well."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "has availed the opportunity"** is incorrect because "avail" requires a reflexive pronoun ("himself").
 
• **Option 3: "took the avail opportunity"** is incorrect as it is not a proper phrase in English.
 
• **Option 4: "availed to opportunity"** is incorrect because "avail" is not used with the preposition "to."
